newsitem.title: USA: Thomson's financial group gets new CEO.
newsitem.headline: Thomson's financial group gets new CEO.

text.p: Thomson Financial Services, a subsidiary of Toronto-based Thomson Corp announced Wednesday that David J.S. Flaschen has been appointed president and chief executive officer, effective March 3.
Flaschen, 41, was most recently chairman and CEO of Donnelley Marketing Inc, which was acquired by Atlanta-based First Data Corp in September 1996.

He will be responsible for the management and strategic direction of Thomson Financial Services which had revenues of nearly $750 million in 1996. The subsidiary, with more than 4,500 employees, provides financial information, research, analysis and software to the investment and corporate communities.
